message:
feat: Add URL query param routing for all pages

- Add useUrlState and useUrlBooleanState hooks for URL state sync
- App.tsx: ?tab=chronology|timeline|locations|knowledge
- Chronology: ?q=search&doctor=Fourth&sort=title&missing=1&episode=123
- Knowledge Graph: ?gq=search&cat=enemies&node=42&view=browse
- Timeline: ?era=classic|modern&doc=4
- Locations: ?city=Cardiff&type=studio&loc=locationName

Also fixes synopsis truncation - now shows full episode synopsis.

All state is now shareable via URL - users can share exact view states.

feat: Add GitHub Pages deployment with embedded deciduous graph viewer

- Configure Vite to build to docs/ for GitHub Pages
- Set base path to /danielle_who/ for correct asset loading
- Move deciduous graph viewer to docs/graph/ subdirectory
- Add view toggle between Interactive Graph (iframe) and Browse Nodes
- Update all fetch calls to use dynamic base path
- Include all data files in build output
- Add .nojekyll to prevent Jekyll processing

The site now has:
- React app at root with Doctors, Locations, Chronology tabs
- Knowledge Graph tab with embedded deciduous viewer (iframe)
- Option to switch between full graph viewer and simple node browser
